min: def roles (ind tim : Bool) : Bool × Bool := (ind && !tim, ind)
ila: def roles (ind tim : Bool) : Bool × Bool := (ind, ind && !tim)

min: def nSlge (u : Hudud.Wahda) : Nat := pair (slgeF u.cells) (Hudud.jinsN u.jins)
ila: def nSlge (u : Hudud.Wahda) : Nat := pair (slgeF u.cells) 0

min: def Adaq (b a : Alama α) : Prop := (∀ x, b.tutabiq x = true → a.tutabiq x = true) ∧ b.tubqi = a.tubqi
ila: def Adaq (b a : Alama α) : Prop := (∀ x, b.tutabiq x = true → a.tutabiq x = true)

min: def ofRank : List Cell × Nat → Qism := fun p => if p.2 == 1 then .harf else .fil
ila: def ofRank : List Cell × Nat → Qism := fun p => if p.2 == 0 then .harf else .fil

min: def khata (a : Alama α) (p : α × Qism) : Bool := a.tutabiq p.1 && !(a.tubqi.contains p.2)
ila: def khata (a : Alama α) (p : α × Qism) : Bool := a.tutabiq p.1
